household_message.text: Visiting friends for a few hours this afternoon, turn the heat down while we're out.

message_to_household: The gateway will lower the indoor temperature to 17 °C when you leave for your visit. It will return to the usual comfort band of 20–22 °C when you get back.

questions.text: When will you be back? (e.g., "by 17:00", "back at 16:30", or "until 16:00")
